title: C2MS-SP 학습 길이 확장: 일정 학습률 학습과 감쇠 갈래로 150-1000에폭 한계 측정
hypothesis: C2MS-SP(65 손실 + K10 사영)는 150에폭 cosine에서 best 에폭이 144-148로 끝까지 오르고 있었습니다. 59번(C2MS, MSE)에서는 300에폭이 GF2 +0.205 dB·WV3 +0.366 dB였지만 QB −0.284 dB였습니다. 같은 모델·손실을 300·600·1000에폭으로 학습하면 어느 길이에서 validation과 test가 포화되는지, validation으로 고른 길이가 C2MS-SP(150에폭)보다 RR 세 지표가 좋아지는지 확인합니다.
method: WSD(warmup-stable-decay) 방식: 센서마다 학습률 1e-4로 고정한 TRUNK를 800에폭 학습하고, 0.8N 에폭(120, 240, 480, 800)의 전체 학습 상태(가중치·Adam·GradScaler·난수·데이터 순서·best)에서 갈래 B<N>을 내어 남은 0.2N 에폭(30, 60, 120, 200) 동안 학습률을 1e-4에서 1e-6으로 cosine 감쇠합니다. 각 갈래는 N에폭 학습 한 번에 해당합니다. 처음부터 네 번 학습하면 2,050에폭, 이 방식은 1,210에폭입니다(센서당).

arms.TRUNK: C2MS-SP 구조·65 손실, Adam 1e-4 고정, 800에폭 (갈래의 공통 앞부분; 자체 best는 감쇠 없는 참고)
arms.B150: TRUNK 120에폭 + 감쇠 30에폭 = 150에폭 (C2MS-SP와 같은 길이, 일정 차이만 있음: 일정 확인용)

schedule: TRUNK: lr = 1e-4 (constant). B<N>: from the TRUNK state after k = 0.8 N epochs, lr = 1e-6 + 0.5 (1e-4 - 1e-6)(1 + cos(pi j / (D - 1))), j = epoch - k = 0 .. D - 1, D = 0.2 N (the 65 cosine formula over the decay only)
loss: 65 loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss on the original pair (history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors)
ema_note: EMA recorded only (as 65); selection uses the online weights
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE over epochs 0 .. N of the run's own path (for a branch: the trunk epochs up to 0.8 N and its decay epochs), earliest exact tie; test never used for selection
choice_rule: per training sensor, the branch with the smallest selected validation MSE (ties: the shorter one) is the validation-chosen training length; only that branch + P is judged against C2MS-SP on the test (v2.4, single seed 0.06 dB). The other lengths are reported as the curve, not as judgements.
control_note: C2MS-SP = the 65 C2MS_L1S 150-epoch cosine weights of the same seed + K10 projection (on WV2 also the 82 band calibration); 65 raw is reported too
projection: prepare.Projected: the 45/66 observation-consistency projection with the test sensor's Wald operator, conjugate gradient stopped at 10 iterations (K10, 81)

comparisons.official: validation-chosen B<N> + P vs C2MS-SP (65 + P), per training sensor, seed 42, v2.4 RR (threshold 0.06 dB)
comparisons.curve: B150, B300, B600, B1000 and TRUNK best: validation and test RR of each vs C2MS-SP (reference)
comparisons.schedule_check: B150 raw vs 65 raw (both 150 epochs; only the schedule differs): tells how far the branch schedule itself moves the result
comparisons.transfer: WV3 runs on WV2 with the 82 calibration + P vs C2MS-SP on WV2 (reference only)

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained runs are also evaluated on WV2 (reference only under v2.4)

lanes: lane 1: TRUNK QB -> GF2 -> WV3 (one at a time); lane 2: each branch as soon as its trunk snapshot exists, then evaluations; at most two GPU jobs
expected_duration: about 3 days: 2,400 trunk epochs on lane 1 and 1,230 branch epochs on lane 2 (75: about 115 s per epoch while two jobs run, 65-70 s alone); QB finishes first (about 1.3 days)
limits: single seed (42); a positive validation-chosen length is a candidate for a 3-seed follow-up, not a baseline change
the branch schedule differs from the 150-epoch cosine of C2MS-SP; B150 measures that difference
QB validation gains did not reach the test in 59 and 73; the length is chosen by validation and judged only on the test
B<N> share the trunk up to 0.8 N, so the length curve is one training path, not independent runs
precision: FP16 AMP training with GradScaler; FP32 loss, validation and evaluation; factorization in float64 on the CPU
scenes_note: fixed QB scene indices reused on GF2, WV3 and WV2; images for seed 42 (made locally after archiving)
